still.title: Still wallpapers
still.performance: Best performance, no extra resource usage
still.description: Set any still wallpaper from Codelume as your macOS desktop wallpaper.

video.title: Video wallpapers
video.description: Loop a video on your desktop or convert it to a wallpaper that transitions from the macOS screen saver.
video.requirements: Screen saver integration requires macOS 26 or later.

scene.title: Scene wallpapers
scene.performance: Native macOS framework, high performance, higher resource usage
scene.description: Built with SpriteKit, scene wallpapers support multiple layers, shaders, and animations. Scene elements can respond to mouse movement and clicks.

depth.title: Depth wallpapers
depth.description: Separate foreground and background layers give the image a sense of depth.

web.title: Web wallpapers
web.description: Show web content, animations, and live information on your desktop.

native.title: System wallpapers
points: Supports still wallpapers and animated screen saver transitions.
Motion slows to a still image when you return to the desktop.

codelume.title: Codelume wallpapers
points: Supports still, video, scene, depth, and web wallpapers.
Supports screen saver integration. Animated wallpapers keep playing on the desktop.

community.title: Projects & source availability
community.openSourceDescription: We’ll publish the source code for Codelume’s projects gradually. Everyone is welcome to review the code and share feedback.

descriptions.Codelume: The Codelume wallpaper app for macOS.
descriptions.CodelumeBundle: A Swift library for reading, editing, and validating wallpaper bundles.
descriptions.CodelumeStudio: A studio for creating and editing Codelume wallpapers.
descriptions.CodelumeSaver: A macOS screen saver for videos and Codelume wallpaper bundles.
descriptions.CodelumeEngine: A planned engine project for rendering and playing Codelume wallpapers.
descriptions.CodelumeShared: Swift components shared across Codelume projects.
descriptions.codelume-backend: Account, wallpaper library, and file services for Codelume.
descriptions.codelume-skills: Codelume project skills for coding agents.

pricing.title: Pricing

standard.title: Standard
standard.description: All app features are free, with server downloads limited to wallpapers on the free list.

pro.title: Pro
pro.description: Download any wallpaper from the server.
pro.checkoutNote: Final pricing depends on your billing location.

pricing.support: Pro purchases mainly cover server upkeep and help us keep developing Codelume.
